title: Run input
description: What Ratel gives to the runner of one instance. It reaches the instance as RATEL_RUN_INPUT: base64 of the gzip of this JSON.

input.description: Any JSON value, given to the entry point.

sideEffects.description: A tool with side effects answers from a fixture, else from its fake handler. It never runs for real.

fixtures.description: Matched on the tool name and the normalized arguments (object keys sorted). Equal matches answer in order, and the last one repeats.
